Q5217.reason: Costco’s confirmation was expressly conditional on the new loading charge, so it was a counteroffer that was never accepted and no contract formed.

Q6156.reason: The unavailable engineer’s deposition is former testimony because the company, as defendant, had a similar motive and opportunity to cross-examine him on the false safety-report claim.

Q8413.reason: The Court treated state immunity as a proportionate limit on the non-absolute Article 6 right of access, so immunity was compatible with a fair trial rather than a breach of it.
